topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite orbital configurations can optimize ML-based QoS by considering link characteristics like latency and jitter, enabling adaptive path selection and traffic routing. Beamforming, spot beam technologies, and phased array antennas reduce interference, increase spectral efficiency, and mitigate latency for sensitive traffic classes.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms neglect satellite link latency, impacting performance; integrated network management is necessary.
